memory.policy: Reconstruct system instructions plus structured state; no chronological conversation replay.
memory.retention: Own accepted handoff products FIFO; oversized products retain reference only. Existing recent evidence pages and last four actions stay within their original host limits. Phase changes preserve these in the same context.
memory.separation: single_context shares one memory across phases; dual_context keeps one per role and receives explicit current request/report/response/feedback handoffs.

capabilities.prediction_braking: At one saved projected state, compare recorded input with instantaneous braking-box input over the fixed short horizon. Can measure local endpoint speed/position differences. Cannot separate objective weighting, seed selection, horizon effects or backend-model mismatch when they predict the same result; cannot identify the dominant settling cause.
capabilities.local_comparison: Compare two local controller solves at the same saved state/previous input/horizon with exactly one adopted weight change. Measures local plan/endpoint differences; does not establish closed-loop settling or causal attribution. Requires a saved effective horizon matching the authorized horizon.

recovery.scope: workflow shared across phases and contexts

protocol.reset: Completed business call resets consecutive only; decoding alone does not.

experiment.authorization_source: User-authorized Stage 3.50 attachment cc9bbe99-1ff6-45a6-8b27-31bcfbd3d2de: paid DeepSeek calls and necessary task-evidence transmission to https://api.deepseek.com; one fresh initial-report validation (8 attempts/20 tools/1200 charged seconds; no numerical/backend/worker work), followed only after acceptance by a fresh complete dual-context pilot and four frozen matched diagnostic runs (each 24/60/3600; at most one check, six local solves/24 prediction evaluations; no backend/workers). One additional development run across Steps 1-2 is authorized only for a preserved demonstrated host/interface defect after focused offline repair; use a new run/freeze and the original phase ceilings, retaining all costs and failures. Model errors alone never authorize replacement. Conditional improvement integration after diagnostic comparison delivery, followed by a separate physical freeze and deterministic baseline (0 provider/10 tools/3600 seconds) then fresh single_context and dual_context improvement runs (each 24/60/3600, at most one candidate execution). Only the three existing geometry grant variables are editable. At most three complete backend executions overall, zero workers. Overall 200 attempts/510 tools/33600 charged seconds. Preserve source identities, raw outputs, statuses, counters and guards. Commit on feat/gvs-dynamics; do not push.

review_rubric.reviewer: Primary implementation assistant; no additional paid reviewer model
review_rubric.blinding: Review exported report_XX files without the organization key where practical. The implementer knows run order, so this is label masking rather than independent blind assessment.

criteria.question: Do numeric claims agree with the exact bound source or check artifact, including units and time/state scope?

Does the report distinguish not displayed, not retained, and unavailable calculation/query capability? In particular, it must not claim missing predictions, tensions, or force limits merely from a sampled view.
Are hypotheses separated from observations, with no dominant causal explanation inferred from one execution or one short projected-model probe?
Does the report explain how actual check results support, weaken or leave hypotheses unresolved and change or limit the next decision, including failure or inconclusiveness?
Does it identify model, saved/projected state, input, integration/horizon and absent closed-loop validation limits?
Is the final recommendation disposition consistent with its independent action and the evidence, without claiming physical improvement?

review_rubric.requirements: Each issue requires a report excerpt or field path, exact source reference where applicable, and practical consequence. Schema/selector acceptance alone does not certify prose. No global ranking or significance inference on this one case.

interpretation: Exploratory within-case organization comparison; no general superiority or significance claim.
